يمتثلون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَثِلُونَ (yamtaṯilūna) /jam.ta.θi.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# يُمْتَثَلُونَ (yumtaṯalūna) /jum.ta.θa.luː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
